_about: Recorded (not synthesized) sound effects. Every WAV listed under 'files' is built from real recordings by Tools/Audio/process_recorded_sfx.py using its 'edit' recipe; Tools/Audio/generate_sfx.py never overwrites these cues. All sources are CC0. Edits common to every file: mono mixdown, resample to 44.1 kHz, 40 Hz high-pass/DC removal, trim to the first transient (onset_db) and the end of the tail (tail_db), short fades, peak-normalise to 'peak', 16-bit.

SFX_PipeClank_1.wav.notes: Two hollow 1/2" metal pipes hit together, pitched down 3 semitones for a heavier plumbing clank.

SFX_PipeClank_2.wav.notes: Another hit from the same take, pitched down 4 semitones.

SFX_PowerDown.wav.notes: Mains buzz sliding down ~14 semitones and fading (wind-down), then a circuit-breaker clunk.

SFX_PowerUp.wav.notes: Circuit-breaker clunk, then mains buzz rising ~14 semitones up to pitch (wind-up).

SFX_RadioStatic.wav.notes: Manual radio-tuner scan: static with faint tuning whistles (section with no station audio).

SFX_Rain.wav.notes: Big raindrops on a car windscreen, recorded inside (reads as rain on a window); 0.5 s fade in, 0.9 s fade out.

SFX_RubberDuck_1.wav.notes: Small yellow rubber duck squeezed once.

SFX_RubberDuck_2.wav.notes: Another squeeze from the same take.
